sentences.en: It cannot be allowed to terrorize the populace any longer.
sentences.zh: 不能再让这些人恐吓全体居民了。

sentences.en: The populace was in thrall to the dictator's whims.
sentences.zh: 民众长期受制于独裁者的 whims 。

sentences.en: A "Post-scarcity Economy" requires higher intelligence from its populace.
sentences.zh: 一个‘后稀缺经济’需要其平民拥有更高的智力水平。
